# Greeting rehearsal project

Run `npm run check` with Node 22+. No package installation is needed.

The agreed work lives in [the release roadmap](docs/roadmaps/release/index.md).
Start with its existing [greeting breakout](docs/roadmaps/release/greeting.md).
The baseline contract is already complete and its dated evidence must survive execution.

The failure command is intentionally red; it is required only by the failed-check variant.
The decision variant needs a real user answer and supplies no default.
